follow.unreadable: This view stopped updating because the chat file could not be read ({{error}}). It shows what loaded before that.
follow.free: No other omp window appears to have this chat open.
follow.refused: The check found the chat may still be open elsewhere, so it stays read-only.

ownerUnverified.text: visual-omp can't tell on Windows whether a terminal also has this chat open. Close it there before replying here.

stopped.error: The reply stopped with an error

series.fallback: omp asked in a form the app did not expect, so it stopped sending your saved answers. Answer the rest here.

state.saved: Saved. omp starts when you send a message.
state.readOnly: Read only. This chat is open in another window, so reply there.
state.readOnlyFree: Read only. You can continue this chat here.
state.readOnlyUnknown: Read only. The app could not check whether another window has this chat open.
